economy.summary: His campaign site says he is focused on creating new jobs, supporting small businesses, and fostering an economy that works for everyone.
economy.short: Focused on creating jobs, supporting small businesses, broad economy.

education.summary: His campaign site says he will invest in schools, empower teachers, and ensure every student has access to quality education regardless of background.
education.short: Says he will invest in schools, empower teachers, expand access.

healthcare.summary: His campaign site says every citizen deserves affordable, quality healthcare, and that he will work to ensure universal coverage and lower the cost of prescription drugs.
healthcare.short: Supports affordable healthcare, universal coverage, lower prescription costs.

energy.summary: His campaign site lists climate change as a critical issue and says he will lead with policies that protect the environment, reduce emissions, and invest in clean energy.
energy.short: Says he will reduce emissions and invest in clean energy.

guns.summary: His campaign site's public-safety platform says he is committed to making neighborhoods safer by supporting law enforcement, investing in community programs, and tackling the root causes of crime; it does not detail a firearms-specific position.
guns.short: Public-safety platform: support police, community programs, crime's root causes.

abortion.summary: A reproductive-rights vote tracker classifies him as pro-choice, citing his 2023 sponsorship of a bill to restrict health-facility acquisitions that would reduce access to reproductive services and his votes against several abortion-restriction measures.
abortion.short: Vote tracker classifies him pro-choice; voted against abortion restrictions.
